notes:
v0.6.46: Config backup / restore (sbitx toolbox pattern).

Per operator 2026-09-09 21:38 MDT: "can we extract the
config files from the g90's to back them up or to add them
back to a fresh image? on the sbitx it has a toolbox app
that allows you to just save the various config files for
this reason. is that a difficult build?"

Build: not difficult. ~250 lines of Flask + 350 lines of
helper module. Pattern source: sbitx toolbox.

Two new pages in the launcher:

GET /backup-configs

    Builds a .tar.gz of the live box's whitelisted config
    files and returns it as a download. A copy is also
    persisted on the box at
    /home/pi/shared_launcher/backups/, rotated to last
    5. The tarball filename is

        g90-configs-<hostname>-<version>-<timestamp>.tar.gz

    so a multi-box operator can tell which box an archive
    came from.

GET /restore-configs

    Upload form. Operator can either upload a tarball OR
    pick from the last 5 in-box archives (no need to
    download + re-upload).

POST /restore-configs/preview

    Extracts the upload to a staging dir, computes a diff
    against the live files, renders a table showing
    add/replace/skip per file, plus a confirm button.

POST /restore-configs/apply/<token>

    Copies staged files to live paths, wipes the staging
    dir, restarts affected services (freedvtnc2,
    reticulumhf-rnsd, meshchatx, g90-shared-launcher).
    The launcher is in the restart list so the operator
    sees the page's redirect interrupted — refresh after
    ~5s.

POST /restore-configs/cancel/<token>

    Wipes the staging dir, returns to the upload form.

Whitelist (closed; operator 2026-09-09 21:38 MDT:

  /home/pi/.reticulum/config               (Reticulum + interfaces)
  /etc/reticulumhf/config.env             (if exists)
  /home/pi/.config/pat/                    (PAT config)
  /home/pi/.config/modem73/                (modem73 audio, etc.)
  /home/pi/.config/ardopc/                 (ARDOP if any)
  /home/pi/.config/direwolf/               (Direwolf if any)
  /home/pi/.config/js8call/                (NEW)
  /home/pi/.config/fldigi/                 (NEW)
  /home/pi/.config/flrig/                  (NEW)
  /home/pi/.config/wsjtx/                  (NEW)
  /home/pi/.config/hamlib/                 (hamlib configs)
  /home/pi/.config/pavucontrol.ini
  /etc/hostapd/hostapd.conf                (wifi AP)
  /etc/dhcp/dhcpd.conf                     (DHCP for AP clients)
  /home/pi/.local/share/patmenu2/          (patmenu2 state)

Box-specific backup (per operator 2026-09-09 21:38 MDT):
"configs vary btw boxes so box specific". The Reticulum
config includes the box's node identity. Restoring a
backup to a different box gives the new box the old
box's identity. This is usually what you want (so the
rest of the fleet can find the new box) but is documented
on the restore page.

Replace-all restore (per operator 2026-09-09 21:40 MDT):
the apply step blows away the existing files and writes
the backup's version. The dry-run preview shows the diff
before the apply button is enabled.

Rotate last 5 (per operator 2026-09-09 21:40 MDT): each
backup-configs hit writes a new file to
/home/pi/shared_launcher/backups/, sorted by mtime, only
the last 5 are kept.

Tests run on m5boss via Flask test client:

  - GET /backup-configs returns 200 with application/gzip
    Content-Type, attachment Content-Disposition, the
    tarball is well-formed and re-readable.
  - GET /restore-configs returns 200 with the upload
    form.
  - After a backup, /restore-configs lists the new file
    in "Or restore from a recent on-box backup" section.
  - POST /restore-configs/preview with a fake archive
    returns 200 with a diff table.
  - POST /restore-configs/apply/<token> writes the
    staged file, wipes the staging dir, returns 200.
  - POST /restore-configs/apply/deadbeef returns 410
    Gone.

Not yet tested on a real g90 box — will be the next
"click Update on g90digi" step.

Operator UX:

1. On g90digi (the shipping box with the right config):
   open http://g90digi.local/backup-configs, save the
   tarball. Or just click Backup on the launcher home.

2. On the freshly-flashed box: open
   http://freshbox.local/restore-configs, upload the
   tarball, preview the diff, click Apply.

3. The launcher restarts (~5s down). All Reticulum /
   digimode services pick up the new config from their
   freshly-restarted state.
